title: Operator Draft Package Builder
outcome: Approved operator staff can create, clone, save and preview an Umrah package draft through a few-click workflow before submitting it for platform review.
actor: Approved operator staff with catalogue authoring permission.
modules: Operators owns package draft authoring and operator isolation.
Catalogue owns package, departure, commercial and payment-plan facts.
Web owns the few-click staff experience and customer-style preview.
Platform owns publication review and approval boundaries.
routes: Operator package library -> create package draft
Draft basics -> stays -> travel -> inclusions -> commercial terms -> payment plan
Saved draft -> submit or schedule for publication review
acceptance: Package creation starts from /operator/packages/new without changing the established staff shell.
Operators can start blank or clone an operator-owned package.
Travel dates calculate days and nights automatically and can suggest a package heading.
Predefined inclusion terminology and NoorPath-approved icons are consistent for every operator.
Visa is labelled Visa included, not visa assistance.
Meals default to breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Intercity travel can be bus or train as provided by the operator.
Operators can choose instalments or one final balance after the initial booking payment.
Suggested payment milestones remain editable and must reconcile to the package price.
Drafts remain private, operator-isolated and saveable before completion.
Preview follows the approved customer package-details visual contract.
Publication guidance states the minimum platform approval window.
Product Owner approval is required before merge and production deployment.
policyDecisionsRequired: Use the existing package-details reference as the preview source of truth.
Keep standard inclusion labels and icons platform-owned rather than operator-defined.
Keep publication approval separate from operator draft creation.
exclusions: A redesign of the staff shell or customer package page.
